contracts.description: Documents as Canonical Markdown with opaque version tokens: list, read, base-versioned revise with Person authority, and live change invalidation.

ports.name: document.list
ports.description: List Collections and Documents in Order Key order, at most 64 per page; pass next as after for the following page. With collectionId, only that Collection's Documents. version is present only for an available body. Errors: documents.unknown_collection, documents.invalid_cursor.

ports.name: document.markdown
ports.description: Read a Document body as Canonical Markdown with the version token it was exported at. Errors: documents.pending (records not yet opened; retry later), documents.unavailable (conflicted, failed import, or a version the token cannot carry), documents.too_large (the response exceeds the Host Port value bound, MAX_UI_PAYLOAD_BYTES), documents.unknown_document.

ports.name: document.revise
ports.description: Merge a Markdown revision of the export at baseVersion as one record signed by the local Installation Person; Agent authority is not supported. Only what differs from the base changes. changed false appends nothing. version may include concurrent edits; read again before the next revise. Errors: documents.base_unavailable, documents.revision_too_large, documents.pending, documents.unavailable, documents.actor_unauthorized. An uncertain command must not be retried automatically.

ports.name: documents.changed
ports.description: Live-only, at-most-once invalidation that may coalesce; no initial event or replay. documentIds names Documents whose body changed; without it, re-list. Re-query on receipt or reconnection.
